image_description: A distant, low-resolution shot of a grey whale surfacing in choppy water. The whale's back and dorsal knuckles are visible breaking the surface, with a small portion of the tail fluke potentially visible or just the rear body arching. The background features a dark, tree-lined shore under an overcast sky.
